# Saskia Fennmoor

Saskia Fennmoor is the Cold-Chain Operations Manager at Nuvix Systems, a company specializing in real-time temperature monitoring tags designed for vaccine shipments and other sensitive pharmaceutical products. Since joining Nuvix in early 2021, Saskia has been instrumental in refining the integration of sensor data into cold-chain logistics workflows, ensuring tighter controls and improved reliability in temperature-sensitive shipping.

Her career in pharmaceutical logistics spans over 12 years, beginning in 2011 with GlacioTherm Logistics, where she focused on refrigerated cargo coordination. From 2015 to 2019, Saskia served as the Senior Transport Specialist at CryoPack Inc., a leading provider of ultra-cold storage packaging. During her tenure, she led the development and rollout of the company’s groundbreaking Subzero Shipment Protocol, codenamed Project FrostGuard. This initiative reduced temperature excursions by 40% during winter shipments across the Northern Hemisphere and set new industry standards for subzero vaccine transport.

In 2020, Saskia transitioned to a consulting role to advise cold-chain providers on sensor integration and logistics optimization before accepting her current position at Nuvix Systems. Her specialties include optimizing vaccine transport logistics by leveraging sensor data, predictive cold-chain modeling, and the operational deployment of IoT-enabled temperature tags.

Among her notable projects at Nuvix is Operation IceStream, a successful pilot program that deployed Nuvix’s latest sensor tags across a multi-national vaccine distribution network. This project generated a 25% improvement in real-time temperature anomaly detection, enabling proactive rerouting and minimizing product loss.

Saskia is known for a methodical and data-driven working style. She emphasizes cross-functional collaboration, regularly coordinating with hardware engineers, software developers, and field logistics teams to align sensor capabilities with operational needs. Her approach values clear communication, iterative testing, and rapid feedback loops.

She works closely with Nuvix’s Product Development lead, the Field Operations director, and several external logistics partners specializing in cold-chain freight. Saskia also mentors junior logistics analysts and participates in industry consortia focused on cold-chain best practices and standards development.
